name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-09-22, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
